games.name: SCP: Facility Breach
games.desc:
SCP: Facility Breach is a casual round-based horror game that features many roles and factions to play as, with many possessing unique abilities! Massacre everyone as an anomalous entity, raid the facility as an invading insurgency, protect the Foundation as a Task Force soldier, lay waste to the EVERYTHING as Valravn, or simply evade and escape. It's up to you.

CONTROLS
Drop Item - (Keyboard: Q) (Controller: Down)
Sprint - (Keyboard: Left Shift) (Controller: Left Trigger)
Interact - (Keyboard: E) (Controller: X)

Us Are Toys is a MULTIPLAYER HORROR GAME which tells a story about a field trip to a toy factory. Fun Factory has invited you to come visit and take a tour of the factory. However, things start to take a very dark turn.

games.name: Trepidation [NEW CODE]
games.desc:
Something evil is hunting you... Complete the objectives and escape before time runs out.

Trepidation is a multiplayer asymmetrical survival horror game where up to 8 Survivors must work together to complete objectives, rescue teammates, unlock the exit, and escape while being hunted by a powerful Killer.

Every match is different. Search for materials to craft items and use weapons or abilities to help you survive. Make risky choices to protect your team before they're killed off one by one...

◉ SURVIVORS: Work together, complete objectives, rescue teammates, and escape.
◉ KILLER: Use unique powers and abilities to hunt down and kill every Survivor before they escape.
◉ PROGRESSION: Unlock new Survivors, Killers, cosmetics, upgrades, and rewards as you play.

[CROSSOVER EVENT AT 13K LIKES]

-This is an ongoing passion project worked on and maintained by a single developer. Feedback and bug reports are greatly appreciated!-

games.name: [Big Update + 7 X Event] A Menacing Timeline
Eclipsis
games.desc:
Eclipsis is in alpha, expect bugs and incomplete features.
Private servers let you customize all kinds of match settings and play unrated matches.

A few hundred light-years away from Earth is the world of Eclipsis. Here, you are a mercenary fighting to secure supplies of Iridium for a mega corporation that hired you. Defeat your opponents by utilizing this wondrous material to build defenses, weapons, gadgets, and vehicles. Weave pipelines through the ruins of an ancient alien civilization as you dominate your foes.

One must wonder, though, what brought the end of this world's original owners. Who knows? At least you're getting paid.

Premium Benefits:
- One extra daily quest
